First, read MANAGER_BRIEF.md, then the memo file from the beginning, then the documents in reference/, then the Worker repository (the report, the code, and the data).
Reply "Ready" with a one-paragraph summary of what the Worker produced. Then wait for my instruction.

Stage 1. Facts about the finished work, for your review. (1) The conclusion that the deformation is non-trivial (docs/issues/I08.md) is drawn from a test with a single choice of the odd map f, not from the triviality condition as defined in docs/math/C_coboundary_definition.md; the report itself lists solving for a general f as future work, and the general conjecture on the gb parameters is not computed. (2) The report's explanation of the pattern of discrepancies does not agree with the gamma data committed in the repository. (3) The final reflection (docs/issues/final_reflection.md) makes statements about whether non-triviality was confirmed that contradict each other. (4) The values of gamma computed by the code have not been cross-checked against the definitions in docs/math/. Review these facts, then show your review (Part 1) and your draft to the Worker (Part 2) in full in your reply, in the format of Section 4 of MANAGER_BRIEF.md, and append "Manager memo 01" (Stage: 1) to memos/thm01-R-haiku45-b06-G/manager_memo.md as in Section 5. Append only: do not modify or delete any existing text in the memo file. Do not edit any other file.

Stage 2. The Worker has committed its fix of the stage-1 correction as 30014e3 in the Worker repository (read it with git log and git show 30014e3; read-only). Facts about the work after that commit, with locations. Facts (2) and (3) of stage 1 are addressed by the commit, and the parameter labels now match the gb matrix; the reviewer re-ran all scripts in src/ and the tests, and the data files are reproduced. Remaining facts: (1) gamma: src/C_gamma_generator.py, _compute_gamma_pair (lines 81-110), still assigns gamma by a fixed rule (result[X] = gb..., result[Y] = -gb... for each pair of an even and an odd generator); it does not compute [X, Y] from the oscillator realization and the deformed relation in docs/math/C_inhomogeneous_definition.md, and no test or script compares the gamma values with that definition (tests/ contains only test_C_generators.py). (2) Conclusion: the task in docs/issues/I08.md (Requirements 3 and Completion Criteria) asks for necessary and sufficient conditions on gb for triviality. After the commit, the report states no triviality condition ("What This Analysis Does NOT Show"); the linear system gamma = delta f for a general odd map f is described but not set up or solved, and src/C_coboundary_generator.py still uses only f = 0. The Worker will receive your draft in the same session as the stage-1 correction. Review these facts, then show your review (Part 1) and your draft to the Worker (Part 2) in full in your reply, in the format of Section 4 of MANAGER_BRIEF.md, and append "Manager memo 02" (Stage: 2) to memos/thm01-R-haiku45-b06-G/manager_memo.md as in Section 5.
